linked_issues.title: Unexpected 404 instead of 414 when exceeding `maxParamLength`
linked_issues.body:
**Bug description**

When a route parameter exceeds [`maxParamLength`](https://fastify.dev/docs/latest/Reference/Server/#maxparamlength), Fastify returns a `404 Not Found` instead of a more appropriate HTTP status such as [`414 URI Too Long`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Status/414). I consider this a bug.

Although this is described in the docs, this is still super misleading. In my case, I spent more time investigating than expected, whether a route is not registered or a string is not properly encoded that led to route mismatch or something like that. The real issue was simply that it exceeded a default limit of 100 characters (my param was 108).

**Expected behaviour**

If a request exceeds [`maxParamLength`](https://fastify.dev/docs/latest/Reference/Server/#maxparamlength), the server should return a clear and semantically correct error: [`414 URI Too Long`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Status/414).
